title: Freshness lifetimes, a free freshness benchmark and census hints from lookups
goal: Each source has a freshness lifetime from its own change history and a lookup revalidates only sources past it; a free benchmark measures the share of current, moved, not-found and source-dated lines and the time per question; and the census and refresh skip re-fetching a source a lookup revalidated within its provider's pacing, dating only what they confirm
